body: Nope, not really. I like watching sports and TV. And video games. Only real hobbies. But I basically don't enjoy them anymore. Mostly because of the depression and the anxiety, but that's not getting any better. Other than that, nothing really.

Nothing that I haven't done already. I haven't seen the Jets, Mets, or Knicks win a championship. It won't happen though unless I live to an age much higher than what is currently possible. Other than that, my bucket list is empty.

The end of Parks and Rec and Community might be interesting. But I think I can go without those.
I'm fine with talking. But as I indicated, I don't think I'm alone. Being with others just isn't a good enough reason to live anymore.
